context: Adds a request timeout to the geocoding client so a slow upstream can't hang the caller indefinitely.
explanation: This is a solid fix: an AbortController tied to a setTimeout bounds how long the fetch can hang, the timer is cleared in a finally block so it never outlives the request (no leaked timers on the happy path), and the timeout is configurable via a default parameter. A slow or unresponsive geocoding provider can no longer stall requests forever.
